**Wrote the 4.2.0 section into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Behind ~380 commits of dep bumps and refactors, nine things actually touch users:

| Type | Change |
|---|---|
| Breaking | expired tokens now return `401`, not `403` |
| Added | webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff |
| Fixed | trailing-slash paths, null-cursor paginator crashes (api/queue/db/webhooks), duplicate response header, empty-allowlist handling, trace id dropped on retry, wrong latency histogram units, full request body in logs, HTTP client timer/pool leaks |

Each of these showed up as the same fix landing separately in several modules, so I merged them into one line per bug rather than listing every module's commit.

Worth a second look before you ship: the `401`/`403` change reads as breaking to me, but confirm with whoever owns auth before it goes out as one.
